plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted an instrument on the live tables after the promotion. I would also have wanted one that applies the requester's category rule, and one that checks every read at once. The library has only scope of a call, which is for named lines and is asked for during the work, and trace of a call, which is for named lines at A3. Those are the only ways to cover C5 and C10, and they are paid from the allowance. C3 has no instrument at all, so it cannot be told from the answers.
